title: Dark Rotation
text:
Walkthrough

The first thing you have to do is pull the lever to start rotating the world. You will only have a single light to show what's nearby. Next, on the first downward slope, wait for the ladder to be visible, then jump to it when it is safe. Finally there is a wooden box, where you have to push it to the left, and land on it, then walk right to proceed to the next chapter.
